item.title: Self-Hosted UX Prototyping & Wireframing: Quant-UX vs Wireflow vs Plasmic Compared 2026
item.description: UX prototyping and wireframing tools have traditionally been desktop applications or SaaS platforms — Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD. But a new generation of self-hosted alternatives puts collaborative design workflows on your own infrastructure, ideal for teams with security requirements, budget constraints, or a preference for open-source tooling.
